subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The case of Vanuatu in 2020 is a clear example of the constant and complex challenges faced by SIDS. It shows how SIDS are dealing with multiple crises at the same time and how COVID-19 has particularly exposed SIDS’ extreme and __interlinked__ vulnerabilities.
solution: The correct answer is: **Interlaced** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Interlinked **means connected together in a way that they influence or depend on each other. (एक-दूसरे से इस तरह जुड़े हुए हैं कि वे एक-दूसरे को प्रभावित करते हैं या उस पर निर्भर होते हैं) • **For example**: *The stories in the book were interlinked, forming a connected plot.* • Marked option **Interlaced **means intertwined or woven closely together, often creating an intricate design or texture. (एक-दूसरे से बारीकी से गुंथे हुए या बुने हुए, अक्सर एक जटिल डिजाइन या बनावट बनाते हैं) • **For example**: *The vines in the garden were interlaced, creating a beautiful pattern.* • So, Interlaced is synonymous with the context of the sentence. • The use of the word 'particularly' before 'exposed' suggests that COVID-19 has highlighted the pre-existing vulnerabilities of SIDS, which are interlaced in nature. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Continuous **means ongoing or uninterrupted, which does not convey the same meaning as interlaced. (चालू या अबाधित) • **Severe **means very intense or serious, which is not synonymous with interlaced. (बहुत तीव्र या गंभीर) • **Free **means not restricted or constrained, which is not relevant to the given sentence. (प्रतिबंधित या बाधित नहीं) 3c:Tdc2, The correct answer is: **A lengthy and aggressive speech**.
